name: Order Domain
summary: Clerics of law who command obedience on the battlefield.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.short: Extra spells that are always prepared.
features.summary: You always have your domain spells prepared once you reach the listed cleric levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare each day.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.short: Heavy armor and Intimidation or Persuasion.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and with Intimidation or Persuasion.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.short: Buff an ally with a spell; they attack as a reaction.
features.summary: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that targets an ally, that ally can use its reaction immediately after the spell to make one weapon attack against a creature you choose.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.short: Charm creatures within 30 ft. and make them drop items.
features.summary: As an action, each creature of your choice within 30 ft. makes a WIS save or is charmed by you until the end of your next turn; you can make them drop what they hold.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.short: Cast enchantment spells as a bonus action.
features.summary: When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action, you can cast it as a bonus action instead. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.short: Once per turn, weapon hits deal +1d8 psychic (2d8 at 14th).
features.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 psychic damage. At 14th level the extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.short: Divine Strike curses a foe: the next ally hit adds 2d8 psychic.
features.summary: When you deal Divine Strike damage, you can curse the creature until the start of your next turn: the next time an ally hits it, it takes an extra 2d8 psychic damage and the curse ends. Once per turn.
